description: Evaluation set for dense retrieval. 'expected' lists the document_id(s) that a correct retrieval should surface; a document hit is any of them in the top-k. 'expectedChunk' is optional and, where set, marks the chunk_index that actually contains the answer (chunk metrics are computed only over those queries). 'filters' is optional metadata; it is ignored in dense mode and applied in Dense + metadata mode.
